title: Hibiscus Flower Anatomy
author: fablefarm
description:
This model is a colourful, 3D-printable hibiscus flower anatomy teaching aid, designed to make primary school biology hands-on, visual, and easy to understand.

Created as an educational classroom tool, this first release captures the clear proportions and simplified structures of a hibiscus flower, presented in an accessible layered format that helps young learners identify and understand the main parts of a flower.

The model clearly highlights: PETALS, STAMEN, PISTIL, OVARY, SEPALS

Each structure is colour-separated to support visual learning and classroom explanation.

This version features fixed anatomical layers, making it ideal as:

- A primary school Natural Sciences teaching aid
- A classroom demonstration model
- A homeschool biology resource
- A science lab display piece
- A tactile learning tool for younger learners

It is intended as an educational model — not a botanical-scale scientific specimen — designed for clarity, durability, and repeated classroom handling.

## **Designer Notes**

This is the initial release of the hibiscus anatomy model and was deliberately designed as a solid, layered educational display rather than a fully detachable or interactive system.

Why a fixed-layer design?

- Keeps the model strong and classroom-proof
- Prints reliably on almost any FDM printer
- No fragile connectors or small parts
- Minimal post-processing required
- Optimised for clean multi-colour printing

The goal of this first version was to:

- Create a model that primary learners can easily understand
- Emphasise the core anatomical structures clearly
- Ensure smooth surface quality at 0.12 mm layer height
- Deliver a print that works beautifully in PLA

Printed in PLA at 0.12 mm layer height, the petals achieve a smooth finish while preserving crisp internal definition in the ovary and reproductive structures.

## **Future Plans**

A more advanced version is already on the roadmap. This may include:

- Detachable anatomical layers
- Magnetic or snap-fit components
- Larger classroom-scale version
- Labelled base plate option

If the community finds this useful for schools and educational spaces, expanded editions will follow.

This design was created to make plant biology tangible and memorable for young learners. Whether it lives in a classroom, a homeschool shelf, or a science display — the goal is simple:

Make learning visible. Make it hands-on. Make it stick. 🌺
